results.title: Four Seasons in Java
results.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

results.title: Auditoria
results.overview: In an audition room, Zephyr and June reunite with their past flickering behind. Exchanging dozens of faces and double the glances, they seek to find something to grip within each other. Something that will help to convince, to persuade, to plead. One's truth over the other's.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 2
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 2
results.overview: The second night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on January 20, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and featured two Young Lion Cup 2026 Semi-Final Matches as well as an IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Title Match. The event was headlined by DOUKI (c) vs. El Desperado for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: Red Beast
results.overview: Eetu Salin, a fiery working-class agitator and one of the founders of the Finnish Social Democratic Party, struggles not only with his childhood traumas and alcoholism but also against young radical socialists within the party who are vying for power. Eetu, who advocates for class struggle through peaceful means, joins forces with his friends Väinö Tanner and Yrjö Mäkelin to try to prevent the Finnish working class from being drawn into a violent revolution.

results.title: Encore, encore...
results.overview: On the last night of his closing Cambodian restaurant, Pou struggles to accept his career is coming to an end.

results.title: Grieg: Piano Concerto in A minor Nobuyuki Tsujii in Paris
results.original_title: Grieg : Concerto pour piano en la mineur Nobuyuki Tsujii à Paris
results.overview: A journey through the history of the piano: europiano features iconic works, masterfully interpreted by exceptional artists in venues across Europe.

results.title: 360 bitar
results.overview: A man obsessed with old jigsaw puzzles from the 1970s, sets out on a philosophical journey to track down the six persons in a mysterious puzzle picturing a football match. Piece by piece, an epic story emerges.

results.title: NOAH Lethal Odyssey Tour 2026
results.overview: Lethal Odyssey Tour 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH, held on April 4, 2026, at Tokyo Tama Mirai Messe in Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Quantum Entangled
results.overview: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

results.title: Stockings: Songbird
results.overview: Pop star sensation Marissa sets out to find a slower way of life in small town rural Tennessee. As she settles in she finds the town is not as small as she had hoped for and the spotlight may not have been left in the big city lights she attempted to leave behind.

results.title: Vejigante
results.overview: A story of power and courage ready to captivate everyone.

results.title: Kaalidas 2
results.overview: A dedicated Crime Branch officer, Kaalidas, investigates the disappearance of a child in an apartment complex. What begins as a routine missing-person case quickly turns dark when the child and a dog are found murdered. As more mysterious killings occur in the same building, Kaalidas uncovers hidden secrets among the residents and races against time to stop a killer before more live

results.title: Chronicles from the Siege
results.overview: During the siege of their city, a group of ordinary people struggle to survive amid hunger, snipers, and bombardments, while clinging to human connection, love, and small daily pleasures. Faced with impossible moral choices and deep psychological strain, their lives become inseparable from the siege itself.

results.title: TRY
results.overview: Sam arrives at the wake of his closeted boyfriend, Joe, who has recently passed away. When taking a quiet moment, Sam is unexpectedly joined by Joe's mother, Tia, who has no idea who he is.

results.title: NJPW 54th Anniversary Event & New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 3
results.original_title: NJPW 54th Anniversary Event & New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 3
results.overview: The 54th Anniversary Event was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on March 6, 2026, at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan, and featured an IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship match between DOUKI (c) and Master Wato, as well as an IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Championship match between Ichiban Sweet Boys (Kosei Fujita & Robbie Eagles) (c) and Robbie X & Taiji Ishimori. The event also included the third night of the 2026 New Japan Cup, which featured two first-round matches.

results.title: How Can I Help
results.overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

results.title: Sacrée soirée !
results.overview: Alban, a confirmed bachelor who no longer believes in love, sees his life turned upside down when he falls for Laetitia, his new neighbor... But the unexpected arrival of his childhood friend Samy, and the interventions of the building manager, throw what was supposed to be a perfect evening into chaos. Filmed on March 18, 2026, at the Théâtre de La Grande Comédie in Paris's 9th arrondissement.

results.title: DDT Judgement 2026 ~29th Anniversary Celebration 5-Hour Special~

The show took place on March 22, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by Yuki Ueno (c) vs. KANON for the KO-D Openweight Championship.

results.title: Gluten is a Joke
results.overview: Gluten is a Joke is a powerful documentary exploring how gluten-free living became a punchline in pop culture and the real harm behind the humor. For many, what is dismissed as a trend is a serious medical necessity.  ​Through personal stories and community voices, the film highlights those living with celiac disease and other medically required gluten-free lifestyles, revealing how jokes, skepticism, and stigma can lead to isolation, misunderstanding, and health risks.  Rather than rejecting humor, Gluten is a Joke asks a deeper question: How can we laugh without causing harm?  It calls for empathy, awareness and respect for lived experiences.

results.title: El coraje del matiz (Todas las vidas de Isabel Coixet)
results.original_title: El coraje del matiz (Todas las vidas de Isabel Coixet)
results.overview: Although the whole world recognises her career and the spectators applaud her talent, Isabel Coixet lives in a continuous doubt that pushes her to continue exploring her contradictions. To what extent does recognition or success quench the creative thirst? From where does she get that pressing need to always try to go further? These are some of the questions that Coixet, voicing her thoughts out loud to the camera, leaves floating in the air.
